sources.title: sahilchachra/Muse-Glimmer-30B-MXFP8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Quantized with mlx_lm.quantize_model (mode mxfp8, group 32), keeping the vision path in bf16. The MLX implementation correctly handles this architecture's non-standard pieces (per-layer NoPE on the full-attention layers, final_logit_softcapping, qk_scale_factor, output_multiplier, gated attention, centered RMSNorm).

sources.title: sarvamai/sarvam-30b-fp8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Sarvam-30B is built to run reliably in resource-constrained environments and can handle multilingual voice calls while performing tool calls. This repository provides FP8 quantized weights for Sarvam-30B, enabling efficient deployment with reduced memory footprint and faster inference while preserving model quality.
